blockingFindings.title: The canonical PDF source text is the un-repaired parser string
blockingFindings.detail: DocumentSourceCatalogBuilder.FromPdfParserBlocks takes RawText from SourceFactsBuilder.FromPdfBlock, which is block.Text - PdfTextUtilities.Readable. On this document that string carries spurious intra-word spaces.
blockingFindings.measured: 275 of the first 400 blocks (68.8%) have Text different from DisplayText; 201 carry kerning join evidence.

examples.raw: M I N UTES OF TH E I NTE RNATIONAL COM PARISON PROG RAM
examples.headingReadable: M I NUTES OF TH E INTE RNATIONAL COM PARISON PROG RAM
examples.lineMatchText: MINUTES OF THE INTERNATIONAL COMPARISON PROGRAM

examples.raw: Session I : Welcome a nd meeting objectives
examples.headingReadable: Session I: Welcome a nd meeting objectives
examples.lineMatchText: Session I: Welcome and meeting objectives

blockingFindings.whyItBlocks: The contract requires verbatimText to be an exact substring of the source. With the mangled string as source, the model must echo 'M I N UTES OF TH E I NTE RNATIONAL' character for character for the binder to accept it, and any PDF gold written in readable text can never match.
blockingFindings.notASimpleFix: HeadingReadable is not the answer either - it repairs some cases and corrupts others, producing 'hybridmeetingon', 'New York-Hybrid' and ',,,.' on this same document. PdfLine.MatchText is the variant that reads correctly, but it is per line and is currently used for matching, not as source identity.
blockingFindings.decisionRequired: What is 'verbatim' for a PDF? Either the canonical source stays the literal parser string and the model must echo it exactly, or the canonical source becomes a declared repair and offsets index that repaired string. This defines the source contract for the whole PDF lane, so it is not a fix to make quietly.

blockingFindings.title: Layout geometry is presented to the model in the field named 'style'
blockingFindings.detail: The PDF evidence fills the style slot with { LineCount, Left, Right, TopY, BottomY } at full float precision, for example Left 169.477678125. In the DOCX lane the same slot carries an author declaration - StyleId, StyleName, OutlineLevel, Bold.
blockingFindings.risk: Same field name, two different kinds of thing. A declaration is a claim about meaning; a coordinate is a measurement. Handing raw coordinates under a name the DOCX lane uses for declarations invites positional reasoning in the one place the architecture has worked hardest to keep positional authority out of, and it makes any cross-format comparison of 'style evidence' meaningless.
blockingFindings.alsoNoise: numbering is three nulls on every PDF entry, and tableDepth is 0 on every entry because PDF scope carries that instead.

blockingFindings.title: One structural family is split across five segments
blockingFindings.detail: The Session family has 13 members spread over segments 0, 2, 3, 4 and 7. Segment 7 additionally contains a second series - SESSION I and SESSION II - which is the annex agenda restating the same sessions.
blockingFindings.relatesTo: I7. This is the DAY 1 failure mode, and more severe: DAY 1 was one family across two segments, this is one family across five, with a restated series in the last.
blockingFindings.consequence: A canary run now would be measuring segmentation asymmetry as much as PDF semantics, and the two could not be separated.

recommendedOrder: Decide P1, the PDF source text contract - it changes every downstream number
Reshape P2 so declarations and measurements are not in the same slot
P3 is I7 and can be measured after, since it needs a provider run either way
Only then spend the canary call

P1.contract: PDF VERBATIM = exact substring of a deterministic parser-owned text projection
P1.implementation: PdfSourceTextProjection carries RawParserText, VerbatimText, SpanMap and ProjectionVersion. The span map is recorded while the glyphs are in hand, never re-derived by aligning two strings afterwards.
P1.basis: The match-gap rule, gap > max(1.8, size*0.27), applied to the same ordered letters. Geometry only - no dictionary, no spelling correction, no word guessing.
rejected: HeadingReadable, which B showed produces hybridmeetingon and ,,,.
P1.measured: MINUTES OF THE INTERNATIONAL COMPARISON PROGRAM and Session I: Welcome and meeting objectives now read correctly where the raw string read M I N UTES and Session I : Welcome a nd.
P1.secondDefectFound: Two paths built facts for one occurrence - DocumentSourceCatalogBuilder via SourceFactsBuilder, and PdfCandidateContextBuilder. Changing only the first would have shown the model the raw string while the binder validated the projection, so every proposal would have failed as non-verbatim and the failure would have looked like the model getting the text wrong. Both are aligned.
P1.fallback: A line built from a string rather than glyphs is its own projection with an empty span map, so nothing is blanked and the absence of glyph provenance is explicit.

P2.before: style carried LineCount, Left, Right, TopY, BottomY at full float precision; numbering carried three nulls; tableDepth carried 0
P2.after: style carries Bold, Italic, RelativeFontSize and LineCount; numbering is omitted; geometry stays on PdfSourceFacts for the harness and the audit
P2.relativeNotAbsolute: Font size is reported against the document's own median body size as body, larger-than-body, much-larger-than-body or smaller-than-body. A point size means nothing without the document to compare it to.
P2.thirdDefectFound: The first attempt read bold and font size from ObservedEvidence, which never carries them, so all three fields were constants - geometry removed and nothing put in its place. For a PDF, format is most of the heading signal. BoldRatio, ItalicRatio and FontSize are now parser facts on PdfSourceFacts, and the evidence discriminates: 8 of 120 owned entries in segment 0 are bold.
P2.packetEffect: Total request characters fell from 452,511 to 331,481, a 27% reduction, entirely from removing coordinate noise and repairing the text.

P3.note: Unchanged. It is I7, it needs a provider run either way, and proving it works requires a baseline-versus-I7 A/B rather than a single canary taken after the change.

rerunRequired: B was rerun. Structural checks still pass: 1065 lines, 1013 blocks, 1013 aliases, each owned exactly once across 9 segments, no gap, no duplicate, no risk fusion, no coordinate name in the schema, and two runs produce identical hashes.
